notes: imd/acc Sepolia test run 6: one contract, the ProjectRegistry, the list of projects whose cashback earns points, decided by IdentityMD oracle panels through Intake v2 (0xa43e...de82, paid in the Sepolia test IMD 0x44a1...f89a). It is the code the mainnet registry will use, with Sepolia settings: test run 5's registry (launch #1428) with one rule text clarified, version 3.1 of the panel rules (docs/panel-rules-v2.md: the trader is router hookData, else the router's msgSender(), else sender only if it has no code, never tx.origin; the router itself is rejected as the recipient and the address msgSender() reports is a valid trader even when it is a contract; LP fees don't count toward the fee guard) and owner-only applications: when the project reports an owner() (projectOwner), only that owner or the project itself may call applyListing (NotProjectOwner otherwise); a project without an owner can be applied for by anyone. It is wired to test run 2's live Stacker 0x0457...314d (launch #1294), which is not redeployed: that Stacker is src/Stacker.sol without the mainnet InvalidTrader check, on the live TestIMD and TestSIMD, and PLEA's hook already credits through it; the registry only names it in its questions and never calls it. Anyone challenges a listed project, paying the oracle fee read live from the Intake (0.5 test IMD) plus a 5 test-IMD bond (cooldown 3600 s). Answers are accepted only from the Intake, for its own open request, signed by the oracle signer 0x5598...2982 for this contract, from a 15-seat panel with 11 agreeing. A listed project's beneficiary may hand its points to another wallet at most once per day (HANDOFF_INTERVAL) and never while a question is open. Settling or clearing a question never waits on paying a bond: if the token refuses the transfer, the bond is recorded in bondOwed and claimed with claimBond(to). Questions are filed under chain 1 because the oracle has no Sepolia RPC. No owner; its constructor makes no external call. Test doubles under test/mocks are not deployed.
